subject: English
title: Arun and Maya's Night Time Discovery
hook: Arun and Maya explore the night sky and discover letters N to Z!

slides.title: N is for Nest and O is for Orange
slides.storyContext: Arun spots a bird's nest high in a tree. Maya picks an orange from a nearby bush.
slides.inSimpleWords: Two more letters as night begins to fall!

image.alt: N is for Nest and O is for Orange — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: P is for Pig and Q is for Queen
slides.storyContext: They pass a sleeping pig in the farmyard. Maya pretends to be a queen with a crown!
slides.inSimpleWords: A pig and a queen show us two new letters!

image.alt: P is for Pig and Q is for Queen — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: R is for Rain and S is for Sun
slides.storyContext: Dark rain clouds gather, but they know tomorrow the sun will shine bright again.
slides.inSimpleWords: Rain and sun bring weather lessons today!

image.alt: R is for Rain and S is for Sun — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: T is for Tiger and U is for Umbrella
slides.storyContext: They see a painting of a tiger in a cave. Maya carries an umbrella to stay dry.
slides.inSimpleWords: A tiger and umbrella teach two new sounds!

image.alt: T is for Tiger and U is for Umbrella — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: V is for Violin and W is for Water
slides.storyContext: Arun hears a beautiful violin playing. Maya splashes in water nearby.
slides.inSimpleWords: Music and water show us two more letters!

image.alt: V is for Violin and W is for Water — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: X is for Xylophone
slides.storyContext: They hear a child playing a colorful xylophone in the village square!
slides.inSimpleWords: Xylophone makes a musical letter sound!

image.alt: X is for Xylophone — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: Y is for Yak and Z is for Zoo
slides.storyContext: In a book, Arun sees a yak. Maya dreams of visiting a zoo full of animals.
slides.inSimpleWords: A yak and zoo finish all 26 letters!

image.alt: Y is for Yak and Z is for Zoo — Alphabet N to Z

slides.title: N to Z Complete!
slides.storyContext: Arun and Maya write all 26 letters on the ground under the stars.

points.label: Full Alphabet
points.text: N O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z — completed!

slides.inSimpleWords: All 26 letters learned! You are an alphabet champion!

image.alt: N to Z Complete! — Alphabet N to Z

subject: English
title: Arun and Maya's Sound Adventure
hook: Listen and learn as Arun and Maya discover the magic of vowel and consonant sounds!

slides.title: A is for Vowel
slides.storyContext: Arun opens his mouth wide and says 'Ahhh' like at the doctor's office!

points.label: Vowel A
points.text: Five special letters called vowels: A E I O U

slides.inSimpleWords: A is a special vowel sound we can sing!

image.alt: A is for Vowel — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: E and I are Vowels Too
slides.storyContext: Maya says 'Eee' like she sees something. Arun says 'Iiii' like a mouse squeaking!
slides.inSimpleWords: E and I are vowels that sound different!

image.alt: E and I are Vowels Too — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: O and U Complete Vowels
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'Ohhh' when he sees the moon. Maya says 'Uhhh' when confused!
slides.inSimpleWords: O and U are the last two vowel sounds!

image.alt: O and U Complete Vowels — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: Five Vowels Together
slides.storyContext: Arun and Maya sit in a circle and sing all five vowel sounds together!

points.label: All Vowels
points.text: A E I O U — the five magic vowels

slides.inSimpleWords: A E I O U are the five vowel letters!

image.alt: Five Vowels Together — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: B is for Consonant
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'Bbb' and his lips vibrate. These sounds need vowels to be heard clearly!
slides.inSimpleWords: B is a consonant that needs a vowel helper!

image.alt: B is for Consonant — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: More Consonants
slides.storyContext: Maya lists consonants: C, D, F, G, H... Arun makes all their sounds with her!

points.label: More Consonants
points.text: C D F G H J K L M N P R S T V W X Y Z

slides.inSimpleWords: Consonants are all the other letter sounds!

image.alt: More Consonants — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: Consonant + Vowel = Word
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'B' + 'A' = 'BA'. Maya says 'C' + 'A' = 'CA'. Together they make words!

example.problem: B alone sounds 'bbb' but we cannot hear it clearly
example.solution: B + A = 'BA' — now it's a clear sound!

slides.inSimpleWords: Consonants and vowels work together to make words!

image.alt: Consonant + Vowel = Word — Vowels and Consonants

slides.title: Vowels and Consonants
slides.storyContext: Under the banyan tree, Arun and Maya write vowels in red and consonants in blue!
slides.inSimpleWords: Five vowels and many consonants make all words!

image.alt: Vowels and Consonants — Vowels and Consonants

subject: English
title: Arun and Maya Make Sentences
hook: Watch Arun and Maya build their first sentences together!

slides.title: What is a Sentence?
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'I like milk.' Maya says 'I like honey.' These are sentences!

points.label: Sentence
points.text: A sentence tells us a complete idea

slides.inSimpleWords: A sentence is words that tell us something!

image.alt: What is a Sentence? — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Sentences Need Words in Order
slides.storyContext: Maya says 'The cat sat.' Arun tries to say 'Sat the cat.' It sounds funny!

points.label: Word Order
points.text: Words in a sentence must be in the right order

slides.inSimpleWords: Words must go in the right order to make sense!

image.alt: Sentences Need Words in Order — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Who and What - Subject and Action
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'The boy runs.' 'The boy' is WHO, 'runs' is the ACTION.
slides.inSimpleWords: Every sentence needs a WHO and a WHAT happens!

image.alt: Who and What - Subject and Action — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Simple Sentence Pattern
slides.storyContext: Maya teaches: Subject + Verb = Simple Sentence. She writes on the sand.
slides.inSimpleWords: Subject and verb together make a complete sentence!

image.alt: Simple Sentence Pattern — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Making Sentences
slides.storyContext: Arun and Maya practice together. Arun says a subject, Maya adds the action.

example.problem: I have words: 'dog', 'runs', 'the' — can we make a sentence?

slides.inSimpleWords: Subject + Verb = A sentence that makes sense!

image.alt: Making Sentences — Simple Sentences

slides.title: More Simple Sentences
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'The girl eats rice.' Maya says 'The bird flies high.' Both are perfect sentences!
slides.inSimpleWords: Practice making more sentences with your own ideas!

image.alt: More Simple Sentences — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Sentences Must End with a Period
slides.storyContext: Arun says 'I see a butterfly' but forgets the period. Maya adds a dot at the end!

points.label: Period (.)
points.text: Every sentence ends with a period (.)

slides.inSimpleWords: Always put a period at the end of a sentence!

image.alt: Sentences Must End with a Period — Simple Sentences

slides.title: Sentences Are Complete Thoughts
slides.storyContext: Arun and Maya write three sentences about their day on the wall!
slides.inSimpleWords: A sentence = WHO + DOES WHAT + period (.)!

image.alt: Sentences Are Complete Thoughts — Simple Sentences
